answer: Tidal-lagoon escrow: each fake identity costs 36 hours of real work plus a $180 stake locked for 6 epochs. New identities enter only through a narrow inlet of 5 per epoch into a shared lagoon pool that releases the stake only after 12 independently verified jobs with 3 different counterparties. Each epoch a random tide audit re-contacts one identity's counterparties to re-confirm its jobs; a farm's 1,000 clones share one counterparty graph and drain together. An honest agent pays once and keeps working.
